personagens.desc: an assistant referee (linesman): wearing a plain black referee shirt with yellow trim, black shorts and black socks, a whistle on a cord round his neck. Keep the same face and build as the reference

correr.kit: the claret-and-blue striped club shirt with the number 11 and a small gold star crest

acoes.desc: celebrating a goal on the spot, pumping both fists up and down without moving his feet
fases: both fists held at CHEST height, elbows bent, mouth open shouting
both fists raised to just above SHOULDER height, elbows still bent, same shout
both arms straight UP above his head, fists closed, same shout
both fists back down to just above SHOULDER height, elbows bent, same shout
acoes.travado: the legs and both feet planted on the exact same spot, the hips, the torso, the tilt of the head, the open shouting mouth and the eyes
acoes.muda: the HEIGHT of his two arms (and nothing else)

acoes.desc: celebrating a goal on the spot, pumping both fists up and down without moving his feet
fases: both fists held at CHEST height, elbows bent, mouth open shouting
both fists raised to just above SHOULDER height, elbows still bent, same shout
both arms straight UP above his head, fists closed, same shout
both fists back down to just above SHOULDER height, elbows bent, same shout
acoes.travado: the legs and both feet planted on the exact same spot, the hips, the torso, the tilt of the head, the open shouting mouth and the eyes
acoes.muda: the HEIGHT of his two arms (and nothing else)

acoes.desc: standing still and utterly deflated after having a goal ruled out: shoulders slumped, head hanging down, arms dangling limp at his sides, breathing a heavy sigh
fases: shoulders slumped low, head hanging forward and down, both arms dangling straight and limp, eyes downcast and mouth turned down
shoulders lifted just slightly as he draws a breath in, head still hanging, arms still dangling limp
shoulders dropped even LOWER than the first cell as he lets the sigh out, head hanging a touch further forward
shoulders back to the slumped resting position of the first cell, head hanging, arms limp
acoes.travado: both feet planted flat on the exact same spot, the legs, the hips, the sad downcast face with the mouth turned down, and the YELLOW shirt with green collar and blue shorts
acoes.muda: the HEIGHT of his shoulders and how far his head hangs forward (and nothing else)

poses.desc: he has just missed badly and knows it: standing still, BOTH HANDS clamped on top of his own head, elbows out wide, head tilted back, eyes screwed shut and mouth open in an anguished groan

pulling the CLARET-AND-BLUE striped club shirt down over his head: the shirt is halfway on, the fabric bunched around his head and covering his face, both arms up inside the sleeves, torso and shorts visible below

an assistant referee raising his flag for offside: standing side on facing LEFT, one arm stretched STRAIGHT UP holding a small bright ORANGE-AND-YELLOW chequered flag high above his head, the other arm down at his side, face completely deadpan and unimpressed

crouched down on one knee tying his own boot lace, side view facing RIGHT: one knee on the invisible ground, the other foot flat, both hands calmly pulling a neat bow on the lace of that boot, face relaxed and focused. No scenery, no floor drawn

SQUATTING DOWN ON BOTH FEET (haunches, knees bent up in front of him, NEITHER knee touching the ground), seen from the side facing RIGHT, getting his boot laces completely wrong: his TWO boots are flat on the ground side by side and he has tied the LACE OF THE LEFT BOOT TO THE LACE OF THE RIGHT BOOT in a big clumsy knot between them, both hands still fiddling with that knot, tongue poking out in concentration, totally unaware. EXACTLY TWO FEET are visible, both flat on the ground, and the knot joining their laces must be clearly visible. No scenery, no floor drawn

falling flat on his face mid-stride: his body is pitched FORWARD at a steep angle, arms flung out in front to break the fall, eyes wide in alarm, mouth open, and BOTH ANKLES ARE STILL TIED TOGETHER by a knotted boot lace so his feet trail behind him. He has not hit the ground yet. No scenery, no floor drawn

cenarios.desc: an empty football TRAINING PITCH on a bright afternoon seen from behind the shooter: flat green grass with mown stripes, a FULL-SIZE GOAL WITH NETTING standing in the middle distance facing the viewer, a few orange training cones off to one side, and a low advertising hoarding and an empty grey stand across the back. COMPOSITION: the goal, the hoarding and the stand across the UPPER 45 percent, and the open GRASS filling everything BELOW that, clear from side to side

a shooting-practice area on a training pitch: THREE round TARGET BOARDS with concentric red and white rings hang in a row from a metal frame in the middle distance, at about chest height, with green grass in front of them and a plain fence and a few trees across the back. COMPOSITION: the targets, the frame and the fence across the UPPER 45 percent, and the open GRASS filling everything BELOW that, clear from side to side
